description: Restructure DielineStudio to become the /dieline/editor route, accept template configuration from location.state (React Router navigate state), and implement a proper three-panel horizontal layout (LEFT: properties, CENTER: 2D canvas, RIGHT: 3D preview + selected panel info). Add breadcrumb or back-to-gallery button. This is independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 but should be sequenced after FEAT-002 to receive configuration state.
steps: 1. Modify src/pages/DielineStudio.jsx: At the top of the component, read location.state using useLocation from react-router-dom. If location.state contains {templateId, dimensions, styleId, materialThickness}, use those values to initialize the component state instead of DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS/DEFAULT_STYLE. Look up the template from dielineTemplates using templateId if provided.

2. Change the existing layout from a vertical stack (CENTER canvas + RIGHT 3D preview stacked, plus sidebar) to a horizontal three-column grid: .dieline-main {display: grid; grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 400px;}. LEFT column: DielineProperties. CENTER column: DielineCanvas (full height). RIGHT column: Dieline3DPreview (top half) + selected panel info card (bottom half).

3. Modify src/styles/index.css: Update .dieline-main to use the three-column grid layout. Update .dieline-editor-area to remove the vertical grid-template-rows and make it a single column (the canvas fills the center). Move .dieline-3d-preview to the right column and give it min-height: 300px.

4. Add a breadcrumb or back button in the DielineToolbar or above the main area: <button onClick={() => navigate('/dieline')}><ArrowLeft /> Back to Gallery</button>. Import useNavigate from react-router-dom.
5. Remove the 'onBack' prop from DielineStudio (no longer needed since it's a dedicated route, not an inline component).
6. Add route to src/App.jsx: <Route path="/dieline/editor" element={<Shell><DielineStudio /></Shell>} />.
7. Remove the existing /editor route (it was a placeholder page) if it conflicts, or keep it as a separate 3D mockup editor placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /dieline/editor (from the configuration screen with state, or directly) opens the editor with a three-panel horizontal layout: properties on left, 2D canvas in center, 3D preview on right.
If location.state contains template configuration, the editor initializes with those dimensions and box style (not the hardcoded defaults).
Clicking the back button navigates to /dieline (gallery).
The layout is visually proportional: properties panel ~320px, canvas flexible center, 3D preview ~400px.
Changing dimensions in the left properties panel updates both the center 2D canvas and right 3D preview.
verification: In the configuration screen, change dimensions to 350×250×120mm
Verify /dieline/editor opens with the three-panel horizontal layout
Verify the 2D canvas and 3D preview show the mailer box with 350×250×120mm dimensions (not the default 300×200×150mm)
Change height to 150mm in the left properties panel
Verify both the 2D canvas and 3D preview update immediately
findings:
Completed three-column horizontal layout restructure. Modified DielineStudio.jsx to read templateId, dimensions, styleId, materialThickness, and glueFlapWidth from location.state using useLocation hook. Template configuration now initializes from location.state when navigating from the configuration page. Added handleBackToGallery callback using useNavigate('/dieline'). Updated DielineToolbar to accept onBackToGallery prop and render a back button with ArrowLeft icon when the prop is provided. Changed layout from vertical stack (canvas above 3D preview) to horizontal three-column grid: LEFT sidebar (320px) contains DielineProperties, CENTER column (1fr flexible) contains DielineCanvas, RIGHT sidebar (400px) contains Dieline3DPreview in a container div plus a conditional selected panel info card below. Updated src/styles/index.css to change .dieline-main from grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px to 320px 1fr 400px. Removed grid-template-rows from .dieline-editor-area. Added .dieline-sidebar-left with border-right and .dieline-sidebar-right with border-left and flex-column layout. Added .dieline-3d-preview-container and .dieline-panel-info-sidebar styles. Updated responsive breakpoint to stack vertically on smaller screens. Added missing icon imports (FileText, Image, Box) to DielineStudio.jsx for export modal. Updated App.jsx route from DielineStudioV2 to DielineStudio. Build completes successfully with no errors.

INTEGRATION VERIFICATION (Iteration 1): FIXED routing issue - DielineStudio route was missing Shell wrapper, causing navigation header/footer to be absent. Added Shell wrapper to /dieline/editor route in App.jsx. Three-panel layout renders correctly with properties on left, canvas in center, 3D preview on right. Location.state configuration from configure page correctly initializes editor dimensions and box style. Back button navigation to /dieline gallery works. Build completes successfully after fix.
